QuestInfo.name: Hazardous Materials
QuestInfo.0: What is going on? Talk to the boss, #bGen#k.
QuestInfo.1: #bGen#k looks like he's collected his thoughts. Try talking to him again.
QuestInfo.2: You learned that the arrival of Mr. Hazard has put your branch in a precarious position.

0.msg: As disappointing as it is, what Mr. Hazard says is true. I was informed of it at the meeting.\r\n

1.msg: What was HQ thinking when they agreed to this? I don't want to share profits with those jerks.\r\n

yes.0: They said this planet's under threat of attack and that Hazard's here to protect us.\r\n
yes.1: But it sounds like a load of bull to me. That guy's a magnet for trouble. Whatever brought him here can't be good.\r\n
yes.2: Uncomfortable as it is, we're going to be neighbors with Mr. Hazard for a while.\r\n
yes.3: Just keep your heads down and mind your own business for now. And no fighting!\r\n
yes.4: Whatever you do, don't fight 'em. We just have to wait them out, and eventually, they'll be out of our hair.\r\n

default.0: Everyone's back. Good. Give me some time to organize my thoughts, and I'll explain.\r\n
